title: Road depot
description: One bus, BRT, trolleybus and intercity bus depot as the project saves it (drawing kind `depots`, a list under `depots`), shared by all street lines. Producer: the Create tab's depot tool (apps/web/src/features/depots) with the layout from crates/depot-layout. Consumer: the road simulation, which starts every vehicle in its slot and parks it there at the end of the run (07-simulation §3.2): add `vehicles`, `fleet` and `rules` (see `$defs/analysis`) and call `depot_layout::analyse` (WebAssembly `analyse_depot`, Python `mobsim_kernels.depot_report`) for the driving network and a slot per vehicle. Positions are [lon, lat] in degrees (WGS 84).

id.description: Stable id; street lines name their depot by it (`depotId`).

modes.description: Street modes the depot takes. A line may use the depot when its mode is listed and its vehicle fits a slot.

layout.description: Lanes, slots and aisles: generated by the auto layout and then edited by the planner; null before the first auto layout.

kind.description: Pull-in uses entrances, pull-out uses exits; the street line tool routes depot runs to and from these gates.

lonlat.description: On the depot outline, where it meets the street.

kind.description: parking: overnight parking; charging: parking with a charger at every slot; maintenance: workshop positions (not used for overnight parking); reserve: parking for spare vehicles; circulation: driving area, no slots.

angle_deg.description: Angle of the lanes to the aisles: 90 straight (two-way aisles), 60 or 45 angled (one-way aisles).

vehicles_per_lane.description: Vehicles one behind the other in a drive-through lane; null: the project value `depot.vehicles_per_lane` or fewer, whichever holds most.

vehicle.description: Vehicle the slots are sized for (catalogue id, or `mode:<mode>`); null: the longest of the lines using the depot.

aisle_width_m.description: Aisle width; null: the narrowest the vehicle's swept path allows.

heading_deg.description: Direction of the aisles, degrees clockwise from north; null: the best of the zone's long sides.
Direction the parked vehicle faces (towards the lane exit), degrees clockwise from north.

charger.description: A charger of `depot.charger_power_kw` at this slot.

lane.description: A drive-through lane: vehicles come in at `entry` and leave at `exit`, first in first out. `slots` are listed from the exit end.

aisle_in.description: Aisle the lane is entered from; null: the nearest.

aisle_out.description: Aisle the lane is left into; null: the nearest.

coords.description: Centreline in the direction of travel.

analysis.description: Added to a saved depot for `depot_layout::analyse`: the vehicles of the lines that use the depot, their fleet with spares, and the project values `depot.*`.

key.description: Catalogue id, or `mode:<mode>` for the mode's typical vehicle.

charging.description: Battery vehicles that charge in the depot.

rules.description: Assumption library values `depot.*` with the project's own values.
